title: Holiday Budget Calculator: Set a Cap Per Person
desc: Enter one total and how many people you buy for. Get a spending cap per person, with money held back for shipping and wrap.
lede: Start with the one number you can afford, then split it before you shop.
steps: Decide the total first, from what you can pay off in January.
Write each cap next to the person before you look at any gift.
Log every purchase the day you make it, shipping included.

title: Christmas Gift Budget Per Person Calculator
desc: Work out how much to spend on each person for Christmas from your total budget. Adjust the split between close family and everyone else.
lede: Close family usually gets more. Set that ratio once and let the math do the rest.
stepsTitle: Three rules that hold the line
steps: Give every person a number, even the small ones.
When one gift goes over, take it from another cap that same day.
Stop adding people after the caps are set.

title: Family Gift Budget Planner for Kids and Adults
desc: Split a family gift budget between kids and adults. See a cap for each child and each adult before you start shopping.
lede: For households where the kids get the bigger share.
steps: Agree the per-kid cap with the other adults before anyone buys.
Count stocking fillers and batteries inside the cap.
Track shared gifts once, against one person.

title: Secret Santa and Coworker Gift Budget Calculator
h1: Secret Santa and coworker gift budget
desc: Budget for office gifts, Secret Santa and teachers. Enter your total and headcount to get a cap per coworker and per exchange gift.
lede: Small gifts add up fast when there are many of them.
steps: Check the exchange limit and use it as your cap.
Buy the same small gift in a batch where you can.
Keep work gifts on their own line so they do not eat the family budget.

title: Big Family Christmas Budget: Cap Each Gift
desc: Buying for a large family? Set one total, count nieces, nephews and adults, and get a cap for each so the list stays affordable.
lede: Long lists need small, firm caps.
steps: Suggest a name draw for the adults.
Give one gift per household where that fits.
Set the caps now, while there is still time to shop around.

title: Last-Minute Gift Budget: What Is Left Per Person
h1: Last-minute gift budget: what's left per person
desc: Already started shopping? Enter the money you have left and the people still on your list to see what you can spend on each.
lede: Enter what is left, not what you started with.

preset.a: Other people still to buy for
preset.b: Close family still to buy for

steps: Add up what you have already spent before buying anything else.
Hold back more for rush shipping this late.
If the cap is too small, combine a gift with someone else.

title: Broker Short Pay Calculator for Carriers
desc: Compare what the rate confirmation says you are owed with what the broker paid. See the shortfall in dollars and percent for one load.
lede: Enter the agreed total, any approved extras and what arrived.
stepsTitle: If the load came up short
steps: Line the payment up against the signed rate confirmation, not the load board post.
Ask the broker in writing which line was reduced and why.
Keep the rate confirmation, proof of delivery and any approval emails together.

title: Factoring Deposit Calculator: Fee and Reserve
desc: Enter the invoice, your factoring fee and reserve to see the deposit you should expect, then compare it with what landed in your account.
lede: Use the fee and reserve percentages written in your own factoring agreement.
stepsTitle: When the deposit does not match
steps: Check whether the broker short-paid the factor before blaming the fee.
Look for extra charges on the factoring statement, such as wire or same-day fees.
Ask the factor for the remittance detail for that invoice.

title: Detention Pay Calculator for Truck Drivers
desc: Enter hours at the dock, free time and the hourly detention rate from your rate confirmation to see what is billable for the stop.
lede: Use the free time and hourly rate written on your rate confirmation.
steps: Record arrival and departure times at the stop, with the facility stamp or signature where you can.
Tell the broker while you are still waiting, in writing.
Bill detention on the invoice as its own line with the in and out times.
